verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a documented Public APIv2 with an OpenAPI-based reference. It covers read and write endpoints across controls, policies, evidence library, frameworks, monitoring tests, personnel, devices, custom connections, risks and audits, and OAuth setup is documented. That is enough for a programmatic or AI-driven client to drive the product. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard discoverable paths (probes returned 404 for openapi.json and llms.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
